request: Love Note opens with a stutter every time the composer and keyboard appear; preserve existing UI and business behavior
scope: Client-only keyboard/route lifecycle repair. No API, database, economy, notification eligibility, quota, or send-queue changes. No commit, deployment, or App publication.

failureMechanism.trigger: Open the composer from Home or explicit Write Back
failureMechanism.previousState: TextInput autoFocus on mount plus an immediate focus effect could open the keyboard before the native card appearance completed, causing keyboard avoidance and card layout/transition work to overlap
failureMechanism.evidence: All 5 baseline native samples recorded keyboardWillShow before transitionEnd. These are JS-received native events, not physical touch or compositor timestamps.
failureMechanism.rejectedCandidate: Using only afterUiSettles was insufficient: idle JS before the native start event did not prove that the card had appeared. Final implementation requires the actual native appearance event.

fix.routeObserver: usePageEntrySettled observes native transitionEnd at the route boundary even when data is unavailable; closing/blur revoke readiness, gestureCancel can restore readiness for the still-focused page, listeners are released
fix.singleFocusOwner: No mount autoFocus. A ready, focused composer schedules one guarded focus through the existing UI scheduler; an already-focused input is not focused again
fix.lifecycle: Cleanup cancels pending work; account epoch, current relationship scope, and mounted status fence late callbacks
unchanged: Durable send intent and original idempotency key

counterexamples: Old mount autoFocus fails the new entry-timing assertion
Idle callback before native appearance cannot request keyboard
Delayed content uses appearance already observed by its route
User focus before queued focus prevents a second focus
Native closing, cancelled back gesture, and listener cleanup
Existing incoming, history, draft, send-failure, feedback, and care/Plushie regressions

native.environment: Dedicated iphone se simulator, iOS 26.2, existing com.novame.plushtouchqa isolated native shell; minified Release JS, Hermes, actual LoveNoteScreen, usePageEntrySettled, UI scheduler and MAIN_CARD_OPTIONS; Love Note data/attention/API use synthetic isolated seams. Not the complete production Home/room route or production network path.
native.inputMethod: All UI operations through CUA; no deep-link or driver press invocation
native.sampling: UI-thread Reanimated frame callbacks covering approximately the first 1.6 seconds after the first sampled page frame; does not include pre-first-frame time or necessarily the entire cold keyboard animation. Navigation and keyboard event timings are recorded separately. No concurrent builds or test processes during sampling.
additionalChecks: Synthetic draft text entered successfully and Send button enabled, without sending
Received-note body still opens without keyboard
Header back returns to the QA source without History redirect
limits: Transition/keyboard overlap eliminated in these 20 observations, not a zero-jank claim
Cold and some repeated opens still have slow frames; the largest final measured interval is about 946ms
The small, unequal before/after samples and system keyboard warmup do not establish a reliable FPS improvement percentage
CUA paste uses Mac input; software-keyboard visibility after paste is not counted among the 20 automatic-open checks
Android native, physical devices, production full-route performance, independent compositor traces and all lifecycle combinations were not verified in this shell

delivery: Metro reload required for the client change; no new native dependency or API deployment required
